🧠 Quick safety notes• A merged firmware image is not interchangeable across all ESP32 boards.
• Bootloader, partition table and app offsets depend on the firmware's build instructions.
• Erase flash only when you understand the data-loss risk.
• Hashing identifies a file; it does not prove that the firmware is safe.
